title: Brazil — Presidential Election 2022
description: Elección Lula vs Bolsonaro, segunda vuelta con altísima polarización. Cuestionamiento de resultado por incumbent.
data_notes: P represents polarization_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Polarization index: P increases as opinion distribution spreads. Observation operator H maps simulator state 5D vector to scalar: std(opinion_dimension) normalized by bipolar half-range [−1,1].
